purpose: Derive corrected source re-extraction tasks from C2-LT-B1 source-resolution fresh-review verdicts, so formerly non-eligible rows can be re-read source-by-source before any new reviewed artifact or model admission decision.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one corrected re-extraction task for every selectedResolutionCandidates entry from the source-resolution fresh-review verdict register; preserve routeOnlyOrContextCandidates as split/context metadata only.
currentLimitations: This queue does not contain completed corrected source re-extractions.
A queued corrected source is not yet a reviewed Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade check.
Route-only, hub, directory and prior-lineage candidates may only provide splitting, currentness or lineage boundaries unless later extraction and review justify a bounded artifact.
No queued task may enter model admission, clinical advice, intervention ranking or individual prediction until corrected extraction, independent review and artifact gates pass.

queueDefaults.minimumReextractionQuestion: For this corrected C2-LT-B1 source row, what exact source-specific claim, endpoint, population or setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade trigger and model position can be extracted without overclaiming?

remainingWork: Read each corrected source in context and fill all corrected re-extraction slots.
Split hub, directory, prior-lineage and route-only cases before any artifact promotion decision.
Run independent review on corrected extraction outputs before creating reviewed artifacts.
Keep all model admission and individual-use boundaries blocked until downstream gates pass.

nonClaims: This queue does not change the original C2-LT-B1 independent fresh-review verdicts.
This queue does not complete corrected source re-extraction.
This queue does not create reviewed artifacts for previously blocked rows.
This queue does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, clinical validity claims or domain-claim upgrades.
